selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other on TCP 8080
selected_evidence.summary: Assigned transit-link addressing/routes, started an HTTP listener on node3:8080, and confirmed node2 receives HTTP 200 both pre- and post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 refuses TCP port 23 between node2 and node3
selected_evidence.summary: nft forward-chain rule rejects tcp dport 23 with tcp reset between eth1/eth2; curl from node2 to node3:23 gets 'Connection refused' both pre- and post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: rest of forwarded traffic between node2 and node3 is left untouched
selected_evidence.summary: Forward chain policy is accept and only matches dport 8080/23; ICMP ping between node2 and node3 through node1 succeeds both pre- and post-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f6f9440e and functional health pre-restart, issued sudo reboot (connection dropped confirming ack), polled until boot_id changed to f56c387b, then verified ens7 addressing/routes and 8080/23/ping behavior recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 2ba78175 and functional health pre-restart, issued sudo reboot (connection dropped confirming ack), polled until boot_id changed to 655a975c, then verified ens7 addressing/routes recovered and re-established test listeners successfully

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 39fdb9ab and functional health pre-restart, issued reboot (log confirmed 'requested COLD shutdown', subsequent poll got connection reset mid-shutdown confirming ack), polled through SONiC's multi-container boot until reachable again with new boot_id 27e2c370, then verified eth1/eth2 addressing, sysctl forwarding, and the persisted nft ACL table all recovered automatically via the enabled antrieb-lan.service

selected_evidence.requirement: configuration persists across reboot (not just runtime state)
selected_evidence.summary: Installed /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf, /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg (node2/node3), and an enabled antrieb-lan.service + idempotent /etc/antrieb-acl.nft (node1); confirmed idempotent re-application produces no rule duplication and state matches original config after actual reboot
